writing.description: Document pipeline: research, write, reference, edit

stages.task_hint: Gather and evaluate sources on the topic and return a structured findings list.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the findings list to the writer as the factual basis.

stages.task_hint: Write the requested document from the findings list, matching the brief's structure, tone, and length.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the written document path to the referencer.

stages.task_hint: Read the written document, resolve its citations and sources into a .bib file.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the document and .bib paths to the editor.

stages.task_hint: Review the document against the original task and the sources, returning a findings list.
stages.handoff_note: Return the review findings as the final answer.

programming.description: Programming pipeline: plan, implement, test, review

stages.task_hint: Decompose the task into concrete, ordered steps with the modules or files involved and how to verify each step.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the plan to the programmer.

stages.task_hint: Implement the plan, run the relevant checks, and report the changed files.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the changed files and implementation summary to the tester.

stages.task_hint: Write tests covering the behavior to verify, run them, and report the outcome.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the test results and failure diagnoses to the code-reviewer.

stages.task_hint: Review the implementation and tests against the plan, returning a findings list.
stages.handoff_note: Return the review findings as the final answer.
